# Assistance to Firefighters Grants

![world globe](/profiles/femad8_gov/themes/fema_uswds/images/world-icon-black.png)

* [English](/grants/preparedness/firefighters/assistance-grants)

The primary goal of the Assistance to Firefighters Grant (AFG) is to meet the firefighting and emergency response needs of fire departments and non-affiliated emergency medical service organizations.

Since 2001, AFG has helped firefighters and other first responders obtain critically needed equipment, protective gear, emergency vehicles, training and other resources necessary for protecting the public and emergency personnel from fire and related hazards.

Graphic

![Illustration of a blow horn](/sites/default/files/graphics/featured_illustration_floodmap_des_7.png)

### FY 2025 AFG Update

As of September 22, FEMA has made **1,399 FY 2025 AFG** **awards** totaling **$264.8 million.**

**Additional awards will be made before Sept ember 30.**

Please see the complete list of AFG awards at the bottom of this page.

Post-award letters and information about the post award orientation offerings are coming soon.

## Applying

![alert - info](/profiles/femad8_gov/themes/fema_uswds/images/arrow.svg)

Submit, approve and manage FEMA grants on our platform, [FEMA GO](https://go.fema.gov/login?redirect=%2F), or view our [FEMA GO user guides](/grants/guidance-tools/fema-go/assistance-firefighters-grants) to learn more.

### Connect With Us

Contact the AFG Program Help Desk toll-free at 866-274-0960 or [send an email](mailto:firegrants@fema.dhs.gov).

Fire Program Specialists in FEMA’s regions respond to questions about the program and conduct grant monitoring activities. [View regional contacts](/grants/preparedness/firefighters/regional-contacts).

Sign up to receive bi-weekly [email alerts](https://public.govdelivery.com/accounts/USDHSFEMA/subscriber/new?topic_id=USDHSFEMA_409).
